content: Admission Inquiry Academics / KST Electrical Engineering Krishna School of Technology advances electrical engineering talent through applied labs, smart energy domains, and industry-connected learning. LEADERSHIP NOTE Message From the HOD KST Dr. Samir H. Patel Prof. & Head of Department, Electrical Engineering hod.ee.kst@kpgu.ac.in It is my pleasure and honor to welcome you all to the Department of Electrical Engineering at KPGU, Vadodara, Gujarat, India. Electrical Engineering is an evergreen branch and offers opportunities across industries, public sector, and emerging domains like EV, battery technologies, solar, wind, automation, and robotics. Our department emphasizes strong technical foundations, practical skill development, and future-ready professional growth through quality teaching and applied learning. ABOUT DEPARTMENT Electrical Engineering at KST 01 The Department of Electrical Engineering of Krishna School of Technology (KST), KPGU Vadodara came into existence in 2023. 02 The department has qualified and dedicated faculty members and conducts postgraduate program activities in Electrical Engineering with strong practical orientation. 03 Students are encouraged for project-based learning, applied experimentation, and research-focused academic progression. VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Vision To produce Electrical Engineering graduates with world-class technical skills, capable of contributing as industry experts, entrepreneurs, and researchers 01 To develop excellent technical skills in students 02 To be inclined towards entrepreneurship, research, and innovation. 03 To instill professional ethics and human values in graduates who are  committed to improving society SOFTWARE LAB Simulation and Analysis Tools 01 MATLAB 02 Mi Power 03 P-Sim 9.1 INFRASTRUCTURE Electrical Laboratories 01 Power Electronics Lab 02 Electrical Measurement and Instrumentation Laboratory 03 High Voltage Engineering Laboratory 04 Power System Protection Laboratory 05 Electrical Workshop Lab 06 Microprocessor Laboratory 07 Machines Lab RESEARCH AREAS Core Electrical Domains 01 Distributed Generation System 02 Renewable Energy 03 Restructured Power System 04 Power Electronics & Drives 05 Power System Operation & Control 06 Power System Planning & Reliability 07 Smart Grid FACULTY & STAFF Academic Team Dr. Samir H.
